units: <cite ref="Zevachim 8a:2">Zeb. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>שתהא כ׳ וכ׳</he> that the act of expiation (sprinkling) be performed with the understanding that the sacrifice is a sin-offering. Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 6, a. e. <he>חלוקי כ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01112"><he>חָלַק</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2:1">Neg. II, 1</cite> <he>אני כַפָּרָתָן</he> my life be an expiatory sacrifice for them (an expression of love); <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:13">Esth. R. to I, 11</cite> <he>א״ר איבו</he> [<cite ref="A02216"><he>אני</he></cite>] <he>כ׳ של ישראל</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31b">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite> (one reporting an opinion of his deceased father must say) <he>כך הריני כַפָּרַת משכבו …</he> so said my lord my father, may I be an expiation for his rest.
<cite ref="Yoma 40b:2">Yoma 40ᵇ</cite> <he>כפרת דמים</he> atonement through blood; <he>כ׳ דברים</he> atonement by confession; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּפָּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Leviticus 16:20">Lev. XVI, 20</cite>) <he>שלמו כל הכ׳</he> with this are all the acts of expiation (of the Day of Atonement) finished.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 1:3:2">Y. Shebu. I, 33ᵃ</cite> <he>מחלוקי כ׳</he> about the classes of atonements (v. <cite ref="H01112"><he>חָלַק</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>כל הכ׳ הראה לו</he> he showed him all expiatory sacrifices; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:1">Lev. R. s. 3</cite>; a. fr.
